title: Johan Cruyff's birth chart
metaDescription: Johan Cruyff's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 4.4° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mars holds a trine to Pluto at 0.5° — close enough to weld drive to depth. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 4.4° into Taurus — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Venus. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 14.2° Aries, Mars was at 10.4° Aries. Read together: thought that arrives already in motion; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Pluto — a trine holding at 0.5°. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Mars opposition Neptune at 1.7°, and Venus trine Saturn at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Uranus makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, two placements stand out. Mars in Aries at 10.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Leo at 2.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 8 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 fire, 2 air, 1 earth, 1 water; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 cardinal, 1 mutable. Fire weights a chart toward initiative — starting, asserting, spending energy to find out what happens. Venus crossed from Pisces into Aries during that day, so its sign is left open. Jupiter and Neptune were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Gemini into Cancer during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.4° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
